prompt: In a vibrant anime style scene set at a bustling shipyard dock, the composition is anchored by distinct figures and objects. On the far left stands a tall crane operator in a yellow hard hat, leaning casually against the metal railing with one leg crossed over the other. Next to him, a small gray cat sits perched on a stack of wooden crates, its tail curled neatly around its paws. In the center foreground, a woman in a blue apron is handing a rolled-up blueprint to a young apprentice wearing oversized glasses. The apprentice looks at the document with wide-eyed curiosity while holding it with both hands. To their right, a large rusted anchor rests heavily on the concrete, its chain coiled loosely beside it. A burly mechanic in grease-stained overalls points at a distant cargo ship on the horizon, directing the attention of a sailor in a striped shirt who stands beside him. The sailor shields his eyes from the sun with one hand, squinting toward the water. Behind them, a bright red forklift is parked idle, its forks lowered to the ground. Near the edge of the dock, an old fisherman in a raincoat sits on a weathered bench, tying a knot in a thick rope. A seagull with white feathers flies low above the water in the background, wings spread wide. There is no sunset visible in the sky, keeping the lighting bright and midday. There is no digital screen or smartphone in anyone's hands, emphasizing the industrial manual labor. The crane operator remains isolated on the left, while the group with the mechanic and sailor occupies the right side, creating a balanced visual flow across the busy dockyard environment.
